FN-YLE8266-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 205
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Kerry (Bubba)
Underwood
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/14/2025
House Bill 205 as introduced could decrease potential use tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund and State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the use tax-applicable
transactions that would otherwise have been taxed but would be exempt pursuant to this bill due
to corresponding sales tax exemptions.
